tools.title: Use of AI for Vet Study

1.description: Your guide to a strong start.
steps: Keep your university syllabus beside your subject notes.
Connect Anatomy structures with Physiology functions; revise diagrams together.
Make a weekly space for Livestock Production Management and practical records.
Use your syllabus to plan Biochemistry, Microbiology and Pathology together.
Keep Genetics and Nutrition calculations beside the worked examples in your notes.
Review practical observations alongside the related theory.
Build a subject checklist from your current university syllabus.
Connect Pharmacology and Parasitology topics with Public Health concepts.
Keep LPT, Extension, Clinical Practices and Farm Practices in your weekly plan.
Organise Medicine, Surgery and Gynaecology notes by your syllabus topics.
Connect each case discussion with the relevant subject notes and practical record.
Use current clinical guidance and supervision; study notes are not prescribing advice.
